def max_subarray_sum(arr: list, k: int) -> int:
    if not arr or k <= 0:
        return None
    
    n = len(arr)
    if k > n:
        return None
    
    # Initialize the sum of the first subarray of size k
    window_sum = sum(arr[:k])
    max_sum = window_sum
    
    # Slide the window across the array
    for i in range(k, n):
        window_sum += arr[i] - arr[i - k]
        max_sum = max(max_sum, window_sum)
    
    return max_sum
